digest.component_or_area: LLM completion-verifier gate / structured output parsing
propositions: The completion verifier returns a Dep record (dependency-link) instead of CompletionVerdict when the model quotes a dep record in prose before the verdict, because tolerant_parse selects the first JSON object that parses rather than the first that satisfies the target schema.

Schema-blind selection in tolerant_parse (:82-118) and fenced-block priority in _FENCE_RE (:138-140) preempt a valid verdict that appears later in the same reply when a Dep record quoted from show_ticket tool results precedes it.

The fix requires schema-filtered candidate selection in parse_structured (:212), not tolerant_parse, because tolerant_parse's first-wins contract is pinned by existing tests and its schema parameter already serves json-repair guidance.

A permanent solution must coordinate three layers: (1) provider-native structured output where measured safe with thinking, (2) prompted-path hardening with sentinel channel and schema-filtered last-valid-wins selection, (3) invariant tests encoding the protocol, not instances.
